## Fixes

- **Walkability now matches the game in a map's empty areas.** Cells with no tile are open ground in game, or get the level's blank tile (LvlPrest FillBlanks). The Walkability view, its panel and the brush used to treat these cells as blocked. Now they use the game's own rule. You can paint walkability there: blocking adds an invisible blocker, as it does elsewhere.
- **Monsters spawning outside the play area.** Some levels fill their empty cells with a blank tile that leaves a few sub-tiles walkable. In Dark Temple, for example, 3 of the tile's 25 sub-tiles stay walkable, so monsters can spawn in the void. When a map has such cells, the Walkability panel says how many and offers **Block empty cells**. It works on the whole map, or on the selection when there is one, and is one undo step. Save the map to keep the change.
- **The whole-cell unwalkable flag works on empty cells.** This covers Ctrl+Shift+right-click, Make unwalkable and Block empty cells. Before, empty cells were skipped. Now the cell gets a hidden copy of the map's most used floor tile that holds the flag. Nothing is drawn there.
